zplan.m_intro: You are helping {qui} who is revising “{titre}” in their app. Here is their plan for the day. Explain it to them in English, addressing them as “you”, in simple words, in 150 words at most, in plain text (no markdown, no asterisks, no emoji): in what order to study these topics and why, what they really need to understand for each one (not learn by heart), and the main trap. Rely only on the key points and rules below; do not invent any figure or rule, and say so if you are not sure.
